mechanism: Both drugs reduce glomerular filtration rate and can impair renal function, with trimethoprim inhibiting creatinine secretion and zoledronic acid causing direct nephrotoxicity, increasing risk of acute kidney injury and hyperkalemia.
action: Monitor serum creatinine, potassium, and calcium levels closely; ensure adequate hydration before zoledronic acid infusion; assess renal function baseline and regularly during concurrent use.
